Messages.Author: ALEX HARMON
Messages.Body:

as the one who doesnt get to untap during the untap phase as normal. For
example 1 TGB is played with Masika and Dieter. Later another TGB is
played with Anson and Dieter again. Is this possible?

Thanks in advance...

Alex

Of course, I'd much rather play the TGB's on Masika as the vampire who
doesn't untap in your untap phase, for both Toreador Grand Balls. Then
you just untap him *before* your untap phase, rather than during it. Oh,
and elect the other halves of hte 2 TGB's as Archons, just for fun -
diablerie can't be blocked, and they can't have Blood Hunts called on
them because of the Archonship - Better than Muaziz!!!

I had a setup like that with Masika in 2 TGB's as the unable to untap
vampire, and the other two vampires were (ouch) Francois Villon and
Alexandra (whoopsee!)
